# Calls

[English](calls.md) | [简体中文](../zh-CN/api-reference/calls.md)

[Back to the API Reference index](README.md)

Beta workspaces can prepare, query and end WhatsApp one-to-one voice/video calls. Incoming calls are not currently available.

## Operations on this page

- [`createCall`](#create-call): Prepare an outbound call
- [`getActiveCall`](#get-active-call): Get the account's active call
- [`hangupCall`](#hangup-call): Hang up a call

---

<a id="create-call"></a>

## `createCall`

Prepare an outbound call

Requires is_beta=true; other workspaces receive 403 beta_feature_not_enabled (41002). Incoming calls remain unavailable. Prepares a WhatsApp user voice/video call without dialing immediately. Use to={id,type}, with a conversation_id that is a numeric @lid or @s.whatsapp.net JID of at most 128 characters; bare phone numbers and string targets are invalid. Groups, channels and unsupported providers return 501 unsupported_by_provider; invalid WhatsApp user JIDs return 400 provider_invalid_request. The intended user opens join_url before expires_at, permits the microphone and clicks Start call; dialing begins after media connects. Camera permission is optional for video calls. Only one active call per account is allowed. Preparation normally expires after two minutes; use expires_at, since this is configurable. Connected call duration is not limited by preparation expiry. Treat join_url as a short-lived one-time secret; do not log or publicly share it. Observe call.answered/call.ended through wildcard or explicit subscriptions; outbound calls do not emit call.incoming.

| Property        | Value                                                                  |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/calls`                                                     |
| SDK method      | `device.createCall(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["createCall"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                   |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                   |

### Parameters

No path, query, header, or cookie parameters.

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field             | Required | Type                              | Constraints                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------- | -------- | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `body.account_id` | Yes      | `string`                          | pattern="^acc_[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$" | Public account ID in the current workspace.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `body.to`         | Yes      | `Recipient`                       | -                                         | Same target structure as messaging: conversation_id in id. Initially WhatsApp user numeric @lid/@s.whatsapp.net JIDs only, maximum 128 characters; bare phone strings, group and channel are unsupported. |
| `body.to.id`      | Yes      | `string`                          | minLength=1                               | Channel recipient identifier.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `body.to.type`    | Yes      | `ConversationType`                | enum="user", "group", "channel"           | Standard conversation type; WhatsApp announcement groups remain group.                                                                                                                                    |
| `body.media_type` | Yes      | `string enum("voice" \| "video")` | enum="voice", "video"                     | -                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | Call prepared; dialing has not started.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `403`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | 403 beta_feature_not_enabled (41002) for a workspace without beta access; unauthorized workspace access retains its authentication error.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `404`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The resource or route does not exist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | An active call exists or the account is not ready. For 38000, query GET /v1/calls/active and optionally POST /v1/calls/{call_id}/hangup, or wait for completion or preparation expiry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Call preparation or processing failed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `501`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The account's channel does not support this capability.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Channel unavailable or invalid response. Protocol login restriction uses 30020: stop automatic retry and check the official WhatsApp app. WhatsApp disconnection uses 30021 across messages/contacts/groups: pause dependent requests, refresh runtime, restore connection and confirm running before resuming. It does not prove logout or invalid authorization, nor automatically retry/reconnect/change state. 30010 may include an original reason; branch on codes, not text. WhatsApp group-admin send rejection uses 34012: resolve permissions before resending. |
| `503`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Call service temporarily unavailable. Unknown channel failures retain the existing 502 classification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `201` response fields:

| Field                           | Present | Type                              | Constraints           | Description                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `result.data.request_id`        | No      | `string`                          | -                     | The request ID generated by the server.                                                                                                   |
| `result.data.client_request_id` | No      | `string`                          | -                     | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header.                                                                    |
| `result.data.data`              | Yes     | `CreateCallData`                  | -                     | -                                                                                                                                         |
| `result.data.data.call_id`      | Yes     | `string`                          | -                     | -                                                                                                                                         |
| `result.data.data.direction`    | Yes     | `string enum("outbound")`         | enum="outbound"       | -                                                                                                                                         |
| `result.data.data.media_type`   | Yes     | `string enum("voice" \| "video")` | enum="voice", "video" | -                                                                                                                                         |
| `result.data.data.state`        | Yes     | `string enum("preparing")`        | enum="preparing"      | -                                                                                                                                         |
| `result.data.data.join_url`     | Yes     | `string (uri)`                    | -                     | Opaque short-lived one-time HTTPS call link; never log the full URL.                                                                      |
| `result.data.data.expires_at`   | Yes     | `string (date-time)`              | -                     | RFC3339 preparation expiry, normally two minutes after creation but configurable. Use this timestamp rather than a fixed client duration. |

> This operation may return one-time or sensitive data. Handle it only in controlled locations and never log the full response.

### TypeScript example

```ts
const result = await device.createCall({
  body: {
    account_id: "acc_example",
    to: {
      id: "100000000000002@lid",
      type: "user"
    },
    media_type: "video"
  }
});
console.log(result.status, result.requestId);
```

## `getActiveCall`

Get the account's active call

Beta workspaces only; otherwise 403 beta_feature_not_enabled (41002). No active call returns 200 with data={}, which does not indicate service failure. Active calls expose only ID, state, direction and media type, without links or credentials.

| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `GET` `/v1/calls/active`                                                  |

<a id="hangup-call"></a>

## `hangupCall`

Hang up a call

Beta only; otherwise 403 beta_feature_not_enabled (41002). Ends a call owned by this account. Repeating hangup during retention returns the terminal object. Missing calls or calls owned by another account return 404 call_not_found. End active calls and wait for preparation links to expire before revoking beta access; revocation does not immediately invalidate issued links or terminate calls.

| Property        | Value                                                                  |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/calls/{call_id}/hangup`                                    |
| SDK method      | `device.hangupCall(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["hangupCall"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                   |
| Mutability      | `destructive`                                                          |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                   |

### Parameters
